opening.text: I've been getting short of breath when I exert myself and when I lie flat, and I even wake up at night feeling breathless. My legs are swollen, and I get chest tightness on and off. Both of these started several months ago, after I was in a car accident five months back where I hit my chest on the steering wheel.
